segments.name: Restaurant operations
segments.evidence: The Company operates 57 Gen Korean BBQ restaurants in the United States and South Korea.

revenueModel.text: Guests pay a fixed all-inclusive price for unlimited quantities of food at the restaurants.
revenueModel.evidence: Our guests can order unlimited quantities of food for a fixed price generally ranging from $20.95 to $20.99 for lunch and $29.99 to $33.95 for dinners as of December 31, 2025.
